criteria.description: filterProducts filters by search term: given a non-empty search string, only products whose name contains the trimmed search value (case-insensitive, partial match) are returned.
criteria.evidence: tests/filtering.test.tsx > Filtering behavior > 'filters products by search term' PASSED. Implementation confirmed in productFilters.ts:13-16: trims and lowercases search, filters via p.name.toLowerCase().includes(trimmedSearch).

criteria.description: filterProducts filters by category: when category is not 'All', only products whose category field exactly matches are returned; when 'All', all products pass through.
criteria.evidence: tests/filtering.test.tsx > Filtering behavior > 'filters products by category' PASSED. Implementation confirmed in productFilters.ts:18-20: filters p.category === filters.category only when filters.category !== 'All'.

criteria.description: filterProducts filters by in-stock status: when inStockOnly is true, only products with inStock === true are returned.
criteria.evidence: tests/filtering.test.tsx > Filtering behavior > 'filters products by in-stock only' PASSED. Implementation confirmed in productFilters.ts:22-24: filters p.inStock === true when filters.inStockOnly is true.

criteria.description: filterProducts sorts results: 'price-asc' produces ascending price order, 'price-desc' descending price, 'rating-desc' descending rating, 'default' preserves original input order. Sorting applied after filtering.
criteria.evidence: tests/sorting.test.tsx > Sorting behavior > 'sorts by price ascending' PASSED, 'sorts by price descending' PASSED, 'sorts by rating descending' PASSED. Implementation in productFilters.ts:26-32 handles all four cases; 'default' branch has no sort applied.

criteria.description: filterProducts does not mutate its input array: the original products array passed in is unchanged after the function returns.
criteria.evidence: tests/sorting.test.tsx all 3 sort tests PASSED. Implementation uses let result = [...products] (line 11) and sort uses [...result].sort(...) (lines 27,29,31) — no in-place mutation. Build completed successfully with exit code 0.

criteria.description: FilterPanel search input calls onChange with an updated FilterState (spreading previous filters, setting search to current input value) on every keystroke.
criteria.evidence: tests/filtering.test.tsx > 'filters products by search term' PASSED (search input drives filter update). tests/clearFilters.test.tsx > 'resets filters back to default values' PASSED (search input has non-empty value after typing, resets to '' after Clear).

criteria.description: FilterPanel category <select> calls onChange with updated FilterState (spreading previous filters, setting category to selected option value) when the selection changes.
criteria.evidence: tests/filtering.test.tsx > 'filters products by category' PASSED (getByLabelText(/category/i) resolves, selecting 'Fitness' updates results). tests/clearFilters.test.tsx > 'resets filters back to default values' PASSED (category resets to 'All' after Clear).

criteria.description: FilterPanel in-stock checkbox calls onChange with updated FilterState (spreading previous filters, setting inStockOnly to checkbox's checked state) when toggled.
criteria.evidence: tests/filtering.test.tsx > 'filters products by in-stock only' PASSED (getByLabelText(/in-stock only/i) resolves, clicking reduces product count to 11). tests/clearFilters.test.tsx > 'resets filters back to default values' PASSED (checkbox is not checked after Clear).

criteria.description: FilterPanel 'Clear filters' button resets all filter state to { search: '', category: 'All', inStockOnly: false, sortBy: 'default' } when clicked.
criteria.evidence: tests/clearFilters.test.tsx > Clear filters > 'resets filters back to default values' PASSED: after setting search/category/in-stock, clicking getByRole('button', { name: /clear filters/i }) results in search='', category='All', checkbox unchecked, sort='default', results-count 'Showing 15 products'.

criteria.description: SortSelect <select> calls onChange with the selected sortBy value (typed as FilterState['sortBy']) when the selection changes.
criteria.evidence: tests/sorting.test.tsx > all three sort tests PASSED using getByLabelText(/sort by/i) to change the select and observing reordered product headings.
